claim_label: Gender Sensitivity to AI Employment Risk
description: Women's support for AI adoption falls more sharply than men's as the probability of net positive employment effects decreases.

instances.assertion: Women's support for AI adoption falls more sharply than men's as the probability of net positive employment effects decreases.
Women are more supportive of government intervention to slow AI adoption, especially when job gains are uncertain.
